name: Trunk-tris
description: A relaxing game of Tetris for each radio system, played by the computer, its pieces made by the control channel: grants, affiliations and registrations. NES or Game Boy look, music, high scores.

screenshots.caption: Two systems' games side by side, each piece made by a message on that system's control channel
The Game Boy look: the LCD's dot matrix, its shadows and its slow pixels, in the green of the first Game Boy
As many games as the screen fits; with more systems than that, they take turns
Game over, and one high score table for every system
